messages:
emily (AE): Customer asked about split custody / escrow and emergency zeroize for BYOK with nCipher. They want to know if Redwood can participate in a 3rd-party escrow flow and what proof we can give auditors. Also timeline for a short POC and any incremental costs.

harry (sales-eng): We can integrate with an escrow provider but we do not hold escrowed key shares ourselves. Two workable approaches: (1) customer uses an escrow service that releases shares on notarized request and we call their KMS normally; (2) customer issues a time-locked rewrap key in their KMS that Redwood can call only after certain conditions. Both keep material out of Redwood control.

sophie (solutions): POC plan: 10 business days. Day 0: NDA + contact list. Days 1-3: gateway connectivity + cert exchange. Days 4-7: functional tests (encrypt-only path + escrow-trigger sim). Days 8-10: rotation and emergency zeroize drill with attestation export. Need escrow provider contact and their release workflow doc.

vikram (security): Auditor artifacts: signed workflow for escrow release, sample signed logs for an emergency zeroize event (requester, timestamp, request_id), architecture diagram showing no plaintext egress, and our BYOK appendix. Contract sample clause: "Redwood does not possess unencrypted customer key material in BYOK setups; Redwood will cooperate with Customer and Customer-designated escrow providers to support key recovery or zeroization per Customer-approved processes."

harry (sales-eng): Pricing: one-time escrow integration validation $7k, connector onboarding $3k, recurring bridge ops $800/mo. Emergency zeroization attestation (manual) $1.5k one-time. If customer wants Redwood to broker escrow releases we need legal sign-off and a different SOW.

emily (AE): OK I'll ask them for escrow provider details and expected crypto ops/sec. Can someone own the pricing worksheet and the POC checklist?

harry (sales-eng): I'll own pricing. Tag me once they share ops and SLO.

sophie (solutions): I'll build the POC checklist and schedule the cert exchange slot. Propose Tues 10am PT.

poc-bot: Ticket POC-5233 created: BYOK + escrow/zeroize drill. Owner: sophie (solutions).

emily (AE): thanks team ":raised_hands:"
